You are implementing Task 8.3: Mobile Responsiveness for the Vibe Voyager game.

## Context
This is a Next.js 15 app with React 19, using Motion (import from `motion/react`), Tailwind CSS v4, HTML5 Canvas for the star map.

## YOUR FILES (only touch these — other agents own other files)
1. MODIFY: `components/game/StarMap.tsx` — Add touch support (tap to select planets)
2. MODIFY: `app/cockpit/page.tsx` — Stack panels better on mobile
3. MODIFY: `components/game/NavBar.tsx` — Verify/improve mobile spacing
4. MODIFY: `app/academy/page.tsx` — Improve grid for mobile
5. MODIFY: `app/academy/[sectionId]/page.tsx` — Improve content readability on mobile
6. MODIFY: `app/globals.css` — Add any needed responsive utility classes

## DO NOT TOUCH these files (owned by other agents):
- app/layout.tsx
- app/page.tsx (transitions agent)
- components/ui/Button.tsx (audio agent)
- components/ui/PageTransition.tsx (transitions agent)
- components/game/DialogueSystem.tsx (audio agent)
- components/game/MissionBriefing.tsx (audio agent)
- components/game/MissionDebrief.tsx (audio agent)
- components/games/*.tsx (audio agent)
- app/crew/page.tsx (visual agent)
- app/inventory/page.tsx (visual agent)
- public/images/* (visual agent)
- app/planets/[planetId]/page.tsx (visual agent)

## Current StarMap.tsx (key parts):
The star map uses HTML5 Canvas with:
- `onClick` handler for planet/academy clicks (mouse events)
- `onMouseMove` for hover cursor changes
- No touch support currently
- Canvas renders: 3-layer parallax stars, planet circles, connection lines, academy diamond, tooltips
- Uses `canvasRef`, `toCanvas()` for coordinate conversion, `handleClick()` for navigation

## Current Cockpit page:
- Uses `grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` for stats (already responsive)
- Has `flex flex-col sm:flex-row` for buttons
- Welcome overlay with `max-w-lg`
- All wrapped in `max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 py-8`

## Current NavBar:
- Fixed bottom, `flex items-center justify-around max-w-lg mx-auto py-2 px-4`
- 5 nav items + audio toggle = 6 items total
- Each has icon + label text

## Current Academy pages:
- Landing: grid of section cards
- Section: content blocks with `max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-12`

## Implementation Requirements

### StarMap.tsx — Touch Support
- Add `onTouchEnd` handler alongside `onClick`
- Convert touch coordinates the same way: `e.changedTouches[0].clientX/clientY - rect.left/top`
- Reuse the same planet hit-detection logic
- Increase hit radius from 30 to 40px on touch devices for easier tapping
- Add `touch-action: manipulation` to prevent double-tap zoom on the canvas
- Do NOT add pinch-zoom (too complex, not needed — the star map already fills the screen)

### Cockpit page — Mobile Layout
- The stats grid is already `grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` — looks fine
- Reduce vertical spacing on mobile: `space-y-6 sm:space-y-8` or similar
- Make the welcome overlay text slightly smaller on mobile
- Ensure the act breakdown text wraps properly on small screens

### NavBar — Mobile Polish
- The 6 items might be tight on narrow screens (375px)
- Reduce label font size on very small screens or hide labels on < 375px
- Add `safe-area-inset-bottom` padding for notched phones: `pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]`
- The nav should work well at 375px (iPhone SE)

### Academy Landing — Mobile Grid
- Change grid from whatever it is to `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2` for mobile
- Ensure section cards are readable with enough padding

### Academy Section — Mobile Content
- Ensure code blocks don't overflow (already has `overflow-x-auto` — verify)
- Tables should scroll horizontally on mobile
- Reduce heading sizes slightly on mobile

### globals.css
- Add safe-area viewport meta support if not present
- Add any needed responsive breakpoint utilities

## Design System
- Void: #0a0f1a | Nebula Blue: #4a6fa5 | Signal Green: #6b9e78
- Core Terracotta: #c17147 | Starlight: #e8e0d4
- Use `clsx` for classNames (NOT cn)
- Motion: import from `motion/react`
- Do NOT use `\!` in TSX
- TypeScript strict mode

## Rules
- Read each file FIRST before modifying
- Make minimal, targeted changes — don't rewrite entire components
- Focus on usability at 375px (iPhone SE) and 768px (iPad)
- Test that existing desktop layouts aren't broken by your changes

    97→    },
    98→    [state]
    99→  )

   117→  // Main render loop

   402→    (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
   403→      const canvas = canvasRef.current
   404→      if (!canvas || !state) return
   405→      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect()

   407→      const clickY = e.clientY - rect.top

   430→            state,

   461→
   462→      let hovering = false

   464→      // Check academy

   489→    [state, toCanvas]

   491→
   492→  return (
   493→    <canvas
   494→      ref={canvasRef}
